''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The ''Wheel of Time'' in Greek translates as '''Ο ΤΡΟΧΟΣ ΤΟΥ ΧΡΟΝΟΥ'''. The books are published by '''ΦΑΝΤΑΣΤΙΚΟΣ ΚΟΣΜΟΣ''' (Fantastic World) , normally in two volumes labelled Volume A and Volume B. The books have been released in two main editions with the most recent having covers aligning them more to the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]]. Translations for Towers of Midnight and A Memory of Light resumed following the TV show release. As of October 2023, only the second volume of the final book is outstanding, the first volume having been released early in 2023.[https://www.fantastikos-kosmos.gr/category-258/category-1141/category-265/]

[[New Spring]] has not been published in Greek.

==Book Covers==

===Fantastic World (Third edition)===
The books are all published in two halves with identical covers. We only show the Vol. A for each below. Additionally, new covers after Lord of Chaos do not have new covers with the exception of [[Towers of Midnight]] and [[A Memory of Light]], which were published for the first time in 2021 and 2023 respectively.
